text: DSH Community Plugins Index 是面向 DSH Web 与桌面生态的社区插件目录数据源。它以 community.json 维护插件名称、作者、仓库链接、可选 npm 包名、描述和分类，并供 Workshop 商店目录与 dsh-market 插件清单使用；配套校验器检查条目必填字段、重复 id、仓库地址格式及分类组合。包的 Cordis 入口仅保留兼容用的空操作行，不提供独立设置界面或运行时插件功能。适合维护 DSH 社区插件目录及其商店清单的生态维护者；作为数据源随生态仓库发布，无需额外密钥或账号。

DSH Community Plugins Index stores metadata in community.json for the DSH Workshop and market catalog. A validator checks required fields, duplicate IDs, URLs and categories. Its Cordis entry is a compatibility no-op, without a settings UI. It suits catalog maintainers and needs no credentials.

section: dsh-community-plugins · Community Plugin Index & Ecosystem Catalog for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)

text:
@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-community-plugins README · What it does：- Index data: `community.json` is merged by maintainer review (see the "社区插件索引登记" section of [docs/plugins.md](../../docs/plugins.md)); every entry requires `id` / `name` / `nameEn` / `author` / `repo` plus optional `description` / `descriptionEn` / `npm` / `category` / `subcategory` (`subcategory` is the second-level classification under `category`; see the enums in `scripts/community-index`, and it is accepted only when `category` is set).
- Consumers: `scripts/market-build` derives the Workshop store and dsh-market.com plugin manifests from this file.
- Validation: `node scripts/community-index` checks the index contract (the `pnpm community:check` CI gate runs the same check).
- No settings surface: this package no longer ships any UI (the community plugin card was replaced by the Workshop store's plugin catalog); the inert cordis row only keeps existing profiles and the aggregate resolving it — it contributes no UI after install.

@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-community-plugins README · Most popular plugins：The three most-liked plugins in the Workshop's plugin category on [dsh-market.com](https://dsh-market.com), in the site's default popularity order — every one of them an entry of `community.json`:

@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-community-plugins README · Most popular plugins：| Plugin | Author | Category | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Subagent Management](https://dsh-market.com/#plugin:dsh-chatgpt-subscription) (`dsh-chatgpt-subscription`) | Aa728848 | integration / external-ai | Use GPT models in DSH through your ChatGPT subscription: PKCE OAuth login, credential storage, streaming Responses, image generation, Codex search, quota display and subagent management |
| [Mnemon Memory](https://dsh-market.com/#plugin:dsh-mnemon) (`dsh-mnemon`) | omdsh-dev | knowledge / memory | Cross-agent, local-first persistent memory built on the Mnemon CLI: user profiles, working memory, project documents and long-term Memory Spaces, with import and export |
| [Free Search](https://dsh-market.com/#plugin:dsh-free-search) (`dsh-free-search`) | DDDMUC | tools / dev | Multi-engine web search without API keys: automatic fallback across 10 engines, time filtering, 8 platform searches and a web settings panel |

@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-community-plugins README · Install：This package does not need a direct install; it ships with the repository as the index data source.

Profiles that still mount the old card (for example through the aggregate) can uninstall `@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-community-plugins` from the plugin manager tab in the official Plugins section (effective on next start).

@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-community-plugins README · Known limitations：- The index only carries links; it does not validate third-party code quality or security, and each entry belongs to its original author.
- Making a new entry reach the Workshop site and the store requires running `node scripts/market-build` and committing the generated `market/dist` (the `market:check` gate).
